newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch shares slipped over half a percent on Friday, but dealers said the dip would have been greater if the market had not been supported by short covering on the options market connected with today's February expiry.
The index fluctuated quite strongly, with the AEX moving between 723.77 and 733.68 points, closing near the middle of the day's range down 4.79 points at 728.92.
"The options expiry put a halt to the slide, so the index could slip a little further on Monday," said one dealer, adding that he did not expect a significant correction.
"Several investors are taking profits after the recent strong increase for some stocks," said one dealer.
ABN AMRO, which gained over 10 guilders in just over a week, slipped one guilder to 136.40.

ABN AMRO will announce its 1996 results on Thursday and market players expect a strong increase in profits. "All financials and probably the whole market will profit from good ABN AMRO results," said one dealer.
Rumours of a possible share split had also boosted business in ABN AMRO, dealer said.
Information technology stocks Getronics and Cap Gemini were hit by profit taking, while computer software firm Baan regained some ground after slipping earlier this week.
Baan rose 1.40 guilders to 87.90, well below last week's close of 98.50 guilders.
ASM International, which announced a drop of seven percent in its 1996 earnings, slipped 1.70 guilders to 27.80, but hit a low of 25.30 in early trade.
"The firm is somewhat cautious about 1997," said one dealer, adding this was the main factor for today's dip.
Steel firm Hoogovens outperformed the market and rose 2.00 guilders to 78.50.
"There was positive news about steel firms and higher prices for steel outside the Netherlands and this had some impact on Hoogovens," said another dealer.
Publisher Elsevier was up most of the day after being the subject of acquisition rumours on Thursday. The shares ended 0.20 lower at 30.30 guilders.
